name: Prismatic HeroCel
purpose: Translate an approved real-person likeness and a locked character design into the same polished animated-game rendering language demonstrated by Kineza, without copying Kineza's anatomy, costume, personality, or identity.

calibrationMaster.selectedReference: second approved animated Kineza image from 2026-08-28 calibration review
calibrationMaster.selectionReason: Strongest blend of recognizable likeness, animated facial readability, graphic costume hierarchy, controlled cel-like rendering, and game-ready silhouette clarity.
forbiddenUse: Do not copy Kineza facial anatomy onto another character.
Do not copy Kineza child proportions onto adult characters.
Do not copy Kineza armor, gauntlets, cape, stance, expression, or kinetic FX onto another character unless independently canonical.
Do not interpret this authority as generic anime, generic JRPG, or pixel-art direction.

likenessTransitionEvidence.principle: Derive the style fingerprint from the visual delta between authentic likeness references and the approved Kineza animation result, not from the fantasy artwork alone.

rules: Preserve the subject's strongest identity anchors before any stylization.
Stylization may simplify planes and enlarge readable features, but must not replace face identity.
Hairline, curl pattern, cheek volume, nose family, mouth shape, eye spacing, jaw/chin family, and age read remain subject-specific.

facialStylization.eyeTreatment: Moderately enlarged, highly readable eyes derived from the subject's real eye shape and spacing; never generic oversized anime eyes.
facialStylization.cheekTreatment: Retain real cheek volume and smile structure; organize into clean graphic planes.
facialStylization.noseTreatment: Simplify bridge and tip into readable animation shapes while preserving the subject's nose family.
facialStylization.mouthTreatment: Clean, expressive contour with recognizable smile/lip proportions; avoid photoreal micro-creases.
facialStylization.jawChinTreatment: Preserve subject-specific jaw and chin identity, simplified into clean silhouette geometry.
facialStylization.skinRendering: Smooth controlled volume with broad light/shadow grouping and restrained painterly highlights.

proportionGrammar.head: Slight animation-oriented enlargement relative to realistic anatomy, adjusted by age rather than copied from Kineza.
proportionGrammar.handsFeet: Slight readability emphasis when useful for gameplay motion; never distort likeness or age.

silhouetteGrammar.rule: Primary costume masses must read immediately at gameplay scale.
silhouetteGrammar.shapeHierarchy: Large silhouette first, medium construction second, micro-detail last.
silhouetteGrammar.edgeReadability: Crisp separation at face, hands, footwear, prop boundaries, costume layers, and major FX contact zones.

celShading.shadowGroups: Broad deliberate shadow masses rather than photographic continuous shading.
celShading.highlightGroups: Selective polished highlights on skin, metal, crystal, and fabric without turning the image photoreal.
celShading.materialPriority: Graphic material identity first, texture second.

detailDensity.rule: Concentrate detail around identity, hero props, focal costume features, and signature materials.
detailDensity.avoid: Uniform micro-detail, noisy textures, and high-frequency surface treatment that crawls during animation.

requirements: Readable eye direction at reduced scale.
Clear body silhouette independent of FX.
Costume layers retain identity across poses.
Expression remains legible without photoreal facial detail.
FX must not fuse with anatomy or erase joint/hand boundaries.

fxGrammar.rule: Bold clean energy shapes with deliberate negative space from anatomy and props.

adult.facialStructure: preserve mature brow, jaw, and nose authority

translationContract.instruction: Translate the approved likeness into the canonical character design using Prismatic HeroCel rendering grammar. Kineza is the rendering calibration master only.

forbiddenDrift: photoreal face pasted onto stylized costume
pixel-art conversion when not explicitly requested
